title: try.input
description: Input of the Steps 6-11 sub-workflow (one try of the recipe): the run and try number, the choose.input object for the steps 6-9 call (feedback included, null on try 1), and what steps 1, 3, 4, 5 and 0 produced, for steps 10 and 11. started_at is the ISO time the try began (for the logged times). try is 1 to 3.
